content: Official Next.js docs (nextjs.org/docs/app/guides/testing/vitest) recommend Vitest for App Router unit/component testing: install vitest @vitejs/plugin-react jsdom @testing-library/react @testing-library/dom vite-tsconfig-paths, config with jsdom environment + tsconfigPaths + react plugins. Known limitation: Vitest cannot test async Server Components directly (React ecosystem limitation, not Next-specific) - those need Playwright E2E coverage instead. Community consensus (2025/2026 sources) splits responsibilities: Vitest for pure functions/business logic/sync client components, Playwright (@playwright/test v1.61.1) for full user flows, routing/middleware-dependent behavior, and anything needing a real browser. Playwright can auto-start the Next dev/start server via webServer config.
